diagnosed: REAL, reproducible breakage: ESPN's Akamai edge now returns HTTP 403 'Access Denied' (an HTML body, surfacing in logs as `Unexpected token '<', "<HTML><HEA"... is not valid JSON`) to requests from the bare `fetchJson` helper (scripts/lib/helpers.js) — a lone `User-Agent: SportSync/1.0` with no `Accept`/`Accept-Encoding` header reads as a bot. This silently broke EVERY ESPN caller of `fetchJson`: golf.js (docs/data/golf.json frozen on the 30 Jul–2 Aug Rocket Classic for 39 consecutive runs / 4 days via retainLastGood — flagged `stale-retained` HIGH in coverage-gaps.json), fetch-standings.js ('Football/F1 standings failed', 'Tennis ATP/WTA top 0'), and fetch-results.js (every 'Football results fetch failed'). The APIClient-based fetchers (football/f1/tennis scoreboards) were unaffected because APIClient.requestOnce already sends polite headers ESPN accepts (Accept-Encoding + descriptive USER_AGENT) — which is why only golf tripped the stale-retain detector (its sport was hidden by other coverage while the fetcher was dead). Confirmed header-based (not rate-based) and reproducible against live ESPN: SportSync/1.0 with no Accept/AE => 403; descriptive UA + Accept + Accept-Encoding: gzip => 200 JSON. Production log 31152842549 (2026-08-07T06:07) confirms the same 403s in CI.
fixed: scripts/lib/helpers.js: `fetchJson` now defaults to the same honest headers the working APIClient sends — the shared USER_AGENT (imported from api-client.js), `Accept: application/json`, and `Accept-Encoding: gzip` (the response handler already gunzips; only gzip is advertised since it does not decode br/deflate). Callers can still override any header. One ~11-line change fixes golf, standings, and results together.
notes: PROOF: live ESPN calls via `fetchJson` now return JSON (golf/football/f1 all OK, were all 403); `node scripts/fetch/golf.js` now produces the current Wyndham Championship (with Norwegian player Kristoffer Ventura) instead of zero tournaments; full `npm test` green (1368/1368, 81 files); `node scripts/validate-events.js` 0 errors.
Auto-merge eligible: touches only scripts/lib/helpers.js (a non-protected path). No data files committed — the fetchers self-heal on the next pipeline run.
